segments.text: Hobbies: Guitar.
Likes: Music in general, Ririsu.
Dislikes: Studying.

A second year student at Sumisora High School. While Tooru's a little bit of a luck-pusher, it was shown that his actions are not as great as his words. He is known in his school as a legendary useless person. Tooru plays the guitar. When it comes to music, he can listen to anything, from classical to death metal.
In "Next Relation", after getting a license, he purchases the motorcycle he always wanted.
In "Yubikiri no Kioku":
Childhood friend of Naoki and his friends.
After failing the college entrance examination, Tooru goes to a prep school while working part-time. He still is hopelessly in love with Ririsu.
Taken from Wikipedia and translated from the official site and the Japanese Wikipedia.

A half-Japanese, half-French girl born in Strasbourg. She went on to a girls' high school for various reasons, but it doesn’t seem to be what she expected. She is Chloe’s little sister from Memories Off 6: T-Wave.
From Gematsu

A temporary transfer student from a sister school in Sapporo. He has excellent observational skills and insight, but doesn't go very far when it comes to physical strength. His nickname is "Rui", which also the alternate spelling of his name.
Edited from Gematsu

Born in Hokkaido, she is Kasane’s childhood friend. She is the eldest daughter of the Miki triplets. She takes pride in her energy and good memory, and is a bit of an airhead. She considers Kasane to be like family.
From Gematsu
Born in Hokkaido, she is Kasane’s childhood friend and first love. She is the second daughter of the Miki triplets. Unlike Yuzuri, she is a quiet and gentle-mannered girl.
From Gematsu

Born in Hokkaido, he is Kasane’s childhood friend and best friend. He is the only son of the Miki triplets. He has tremendous love for his younger sisters, and is treated as having a sister complex by others. However, he is very popular among the girls and speaks his mind. His nickname is "Reach."
From Gematsu

A close friend of Noelle's from middle school. She is the daughter of the landlord of Yuunagi Manor, where Kasane is lodging, as well as the heir of the adjacent shrine. While her looks stand out from the rest, she is making her so-called high school debut. She has an older boyfriend, apparently.
From Gematsu

Operator of a recently-opened café called "YuKuRu." He refers to himself as "Master" in regards to said café and does not want to be called "Tenchou." He runs the café together with Shiogane Kyouko. A well of adult wisdom and easy-going, Kasane finds himself frequently going to him for advice, and for the coffee he brews. Most of his acquaintances happen to be women.

Inaho Shin's co-worker at the café "YuKuRu." Both her and Shin had started the café about a year earlier, having left their previous workplace together. To Shin, she's an irreplaceable partner, and to youths, a confident older sister whom you could consult with.
The health teacher at Shounan Seiryoo High School. Her gestures naturally attract men's eyes. She is nicknamed "the witch of the health room."
A freelance writer.
A sophomore. The current student council president with relaxed looks and has "ojou-sama" vibes.
A sophomore at Rinshouji Girls High School.

An old friend of Shin. She works as a nurse and sends off busy days at the hospital. Still, she makes time to visit "YuKuRu" to hang out, and to support the struggling café. Despite being bubbly and naive in ways, she can be keen and intuitive, being able to give advice to a troubled Yuzuri and
spotting Kyouko's pregnancy.

An active pianist in England and and old acquaintance of Inaho Shin. She is alumnus of Hamasaki High School, being one of the more famous people to graduate from there. She has released music albums and is called the "Eastern Fairy" for her prowess as a young pianist. She's in a long-distance relationship with Inami Ken.
To celebrate Shin becoming a father, she sends a video of herself playing a piano piece she composed; that piece is dubbed "Memories Off."

A patron of "YuKuRu" and an old acquaintance of Inaho Shin. She works as a freelance journalist, writing about all sorts of things, but mainly about fashion and towns. She's even been putting out articles about pro-wrestling recently, but she isn't exactly thrilled about it. As a result, she's been questioning her direction in life. She's protective of her younger sister Mifu. Kanami is her colleague through profession.

A patron of "YuKuRu" and an old acquaintance of Inaho Shin. She works at a nursery school. In her free time, she maintains an old chapel that lies on a hill in Fujikawa. She likes riddles and lights up immediately when they're alluded to. Her catchphrase is "Nazo Nazo Tai~" but she's too embarrassed to sound out the end; it's an old habit of hers.
Her real name is Sagisawa Inori; she is married to Sagisawa Isshu and is implied to have a child.

A patron of "YuKuRu" and an old friend of Inaho Shin. She used to be co-workers with Shin at the chain restaurant "Ressac,' but now she works as an rookie camerawoman. She can be boyish and lack delicacy in her speech, but she's earnest and passionate about the things that matter to her most. Her friendship with Shin leaves no reservations between them, which is rare among Shin's female acquaintances.
This aspect can backfire as it was the trigger for the big argument between Shin and Kyouko in the Other Side route.

A prolific novelist and the older sister of Inaho Shin. She is the actual owner of "YuKuRu" but pushed the job of managing it onto Shin. She sometimes holes inside a room on the second floor of the café to write her manuscripts. She sees Noelle as a little sister and will test anyone asking for her hand.

The older sister of Kagamigawa Noelle and an acquaintance of Inaho Shin. She used to attend Aomine University before dropping out to study in France; she lives with her grandparents there. She adores her little sister to the point of being obsessive at times, sending text messages often and hungry to keep tabs. She worries about Noelle's situation in school and is optimistically cautious about Kasane's entrance into Noelle's life.
Her fiancé is Tsukamoto Shio.

Patron of "YuKuRu" and an acquaintance of Inaho Shin. In high school, she worked part-time under Shin and Kyouko at a traditional Japanese restaurant called "Fuuryuuan" and she still works part-time there as a university student. She's not particularly happy about Kyouko leaving, as she feels she has big shoes to fill in her absence. She says "Nanodesu" pretty often; Yuzuri calls her "Nanodesu-san."

Patron of "YuKuRu" and an acquaintance of Inaho Shin. She works as a high school teacher and was the homeroom teacher of Chinatsu. Her students affectionately call her the name "Himechan-sensei." Despite closing in onto her 30's, her looks remain adolescent as ever; people call her the "Zashiki-warashi of Sumisora" in reverence of her eternal youth. She regularly goes to Marinland and is a fan of the children's anime "Let's Goー☆ Peta Peta."

A librarian and an old friend of Yue and Shin. After recently returning to Japan from England, she works as a part-timer at "YuKuRu." Graceful and serene, with a peculiar sense for brewing tea, her presence makes the café more calming and elegant. She feels a strong affinity with Kagamigawa Noel.
